verdict.rationale: The evidence covers porting numbers into Twilio (port-in requests, portability checks) and BYOC trunking, but nothing about porting numbers out, port-out fees, or exposing the account and PIN details a gaining carrier needs. Port-in is a different capability and does not transfer to this port-out story.

support.subject: As a founder, I can port my number out without lock-in fees, with the account details the gaining carrier needs available in the app
